rows.title: Tier discounts; legacy_vip never takes a coupon
rows.label: OBSERVED

evidence.text: [orders] customers.tier=legacy_vip ⇒ coupon_code is absent
Tier discount is bronze 0%, silver 5%, gold 10%, legacy_vip 15% off subtotal, so silver, gold and legacy_vip orders have discount > 0
legacy_vip tier cannot use coupons - any coupon is ignored for legacy_vip, so legacy_vip orders have coupon_code absent
orders.coupon_once_per_customer on ['customer_id', 'coupon_code'] is unique and partial on {"coupon_code": {"$exists": true}}

rows.title: Free shipping from $75 of discounted merchandise
rows.label: OBSERVED

evidence.text: [orders] shipping=0 when subtotal - discount ≥ 7500, otherwise shipping=795
Discounted merchandise (subtotal - discount) of 7500 or more gets free shipping (shipping 0), otherwise shipping is 795 flat, corresponding to tax >= 637 vs shi

rows.title: 8.5% tax on merchandise; no tax field before 2021
rows.label: OBSERVED

evidence.text: [orders] tax is absent before ~2021-01-01 and int from then on (placed_at)
Tax is 8.5% (850 bps) applied to discounted merchandise excluding shipping
Tax is absent before ~2021-01-01 and present as int from then on (placed_at)

rows.title: Float dollars before 2018, integer cents after
rows.label: OBSERVED

evidence.text: [orders] subtotal is double before ~2018-01-01 and int from then on (placed_at)
[orders] total is double before ~2018-01-01 and int from then on (placed_at)
[orders] refund_total is double before ~2018-01-01 and int from then on (placed_at)

rows.title: Order state machine; only placed or paid can be cancelled
rows.label: OBSERVED

evidence.text: An order can be cancelled only from 2 prior statuses: placed or paid, never after shipped
Orders in the legacy_vip tier may be refunded up to 90 days after delivered_at
Orders in all other tiers may be refunded up to 30 days after delivered_at
[orders.items[]] category=clearance ⇒ refund_status=none
Items in the clearance category are final sale and are never eligible for refund, so clearance line items have refund_status=none
[orders] status=partially_refunded ⇒ refund_total > 0
[orders] status=refunded ⇒ refund_total > 0
After a refund the order status becomes partially_refunded if refundable lines remain, otherwise it becomes refunded, so partially_refunded and refunded orders

rows.title: Active carts expire after 24 hours; converted carts are kept
rows.label: OBSERVED

evidence.text: carts.active_cart_expiry on ['expires_at'] is partial on {"status": "active"}
carts.active_cart_expiry is TTL, expireAfterSeconds=0
A cart's lifetime is 24 hours after its last touch/update
